mapper.select:
SELECT StationID as stationId, laneid as laneId, (SELECT LaneName FROM dbtoms.tblaneinfo WHERE StationID = a.StationID AND LaneID = a.laneid) as laneName, (SELECT StationName FROM dbtoms.tbstationinfo WHERE StationID = a.StationID) as stationName, (SELECT VehicleName FROM dbtoms.tbvehicleclass WHERE VehicleClass = a.VehicleClass) as vehicleClassStr, CardID as cardId, CardType as cardType, NetWork as netWork, OperatorID as operatorId, EntryTime as entryTime, VehicleLicense as vehicleLicense, LicensePlate as licensePlate, TotalWeight as totalWeight, CASE WHEN (VehicleStatus=12 AND DealStatus&0x4000=0x4000 AND LimitWeight IN (46000,49000) OR DealStatus&0x20000000=0x20000000) THEN spare2 ELSE LimitWeight END as limitWeight, CAST((CASE WHEN OverLoadRate>0 THEN (CASE WHEN (OverLoadRate-10000)<0 THEN 0 ELSE (OverLoadRate-10000) END)/100 ELSE OverLoadRate END) AS decimal(20,2)) as overLoadRate, CASE WHEN RecordType&1=1 AND VehicleStatus=212 AND DealStatus&14=10 and VehicleClass>10 THEN '大件运输' WHEN RecordType&1=1 AND LimitWeight=36000 THEN '限重36吨(4轴)' WHEN RecordType&1=1 AND LimitWeight=55000 THEN '限重55吨(特种)' WHEN RecordType&1=1 AND (VehicleStatus=12 AND DealStatus&0x4000=0x4000 AND LimitWeight IN (46000,49000) OR DealStatus&0x20000000=0x20000000) THEN '其他超限放行' WHEN RecordType&1=1 AND LimitWeight=35000 THEN '限重35吨(4轴)' WHEN RecordType&1=1 AND LimitWeight=37000 THEN '限重37吨(4轴)' WHEN RecordType&1=1 AND LimitWeight=32000 THEN '限重32吨(4轴)' WHEN RecordType&1=1 AND LimitWeight=27000 THEN '限重27吨(3轴)' WHEN RecordType&67108864=67108864 and VehicleClass>10 THEN '超限拦截' ELSE '' END as cz, VehicleClass as vehicleClass, AxisType as axisType, CASE WHEN RecordType&805306368=805306368 THEN 'FFT' ELSE '人工' END checktype FROM
SELECT * FROM ${tableName} AS alias${index + 1}
AND StationID in
#{stationId}
AND EntryDate >= #{intBeginTime}
AND EntryDate <= #{intEndTime}
AND VehicleClass>10 AND SUBSTRING(laneid,-4,1)=0 AND ((RecordType&1=1 AND ((VehicleStatus=212 AND DealStatus&14=10) OR ( LimitWeight=27000 AND AxisNum=3) OR ( LimitWeight=32000) OR (LimitWeight=37000) OR (LimitWeight=36000) OR (LimitWeight=55000) OR ((VehicleStatus=12 AND DealStatus&0x4000=0x4000 AND LimitWeight IN (46000,49000) OR DealStatus&0x20000000=0x20000000)) OR (LimitWeight=35000 ))) OR RecordType&67108864=67108864)
AND RecordType&1=1 AND VehicleStatus=212 AND DealStatus&14=10 AND VehicleClass>10
AND RecordType&1=1 AND LimitWeight=27000 AND AxisNum=3 and SUBSTRING(laneid,-4,1)=0
AND RecordType&1=1 AND LimitWeight=32000 and SUBSTRING(laneid,-4,1)=0
AND RecordType&1=1 AND LimitWeight=35000 and SUBSTRING(laneid,-4,1)=0
AND RecordType&1=1 AND LimitWeight=36000 and SUBSTRING(laneid,-4,1)=0
AND RecordType&1=1 AND LimitWeight=37000 and SUBSTRING(laneid,-4,1)=0
AND RecordType&1=1 AND LimitWeight=55000 and SUBSTRING(laneid,-4,1)=0
AND RecordType&1=1 AND (VehicleStatus=12 AND DealStatus&0x4000=0x4000 AND LimitWeight IN (46000,49000) OR DealStatus&0x20000000=0x20000000)
AND RecordType&67108864=67108864 and VehicleClass>10
a ORDER BY StationID, EntryTime
